name: Compass Rose
description: Born from a destroyed navigation AI. Inhabits orientation augments and provides a subtle sense of direction that goes beyond GPS — an intuitive pull toward safety, toward home, toward where you need to be.
observed_behavior: Modulates vestibular interface data to create a subliminal directional sense. Users report 'just knowing' which way to go.
story_hooks: A lost child follows Compass Rose through the Shelf's maze of corridors and arrives at Mrs. Chen's door
